req.title: Partial update supported
req.statement: The system shall accept a partial payload on PUT /tasks/{task_id} and leave omitted fields unchanged.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-012 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} accepts a partial payload and leaves omitted fields unchanged. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — sending only one field updates that field and preserves others; (2) negative NEG — sending a partial payload to a non-existent task_id returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — updating title at its minimum length (1 char) and maximum length (100 chars) boundary; (4) DT — updating each individual field independently to confirm isolation; (5) STC — state transition from completed=False to completed=True via partial update. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 not >=200), exact field values for both updated and untouched fields, and boundary ±1 for string length constraints.

tests.name: test_partial_update_only_title_leaves_other_fields_unchanged
preconditions: App is running in-process with a fresh SQLite database
A task exists with known title, description, and completed=False
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a task with title='Original Title', description='Keep this', completed=False
expected: Response body has id matching created task
trace: R-TASK-012: omitted fields (description, completed) left unchanged
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import sqlalchemy, app.database as _db, app.models as _m

_db.SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./test_r012_pos1.db"
_db.engine = sqlalchemy.create_engine(_db.SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
_db.SessionLocal = sqlalchemy.orm.sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=_db.engine)
_m.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=_db.engine)
_m.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=_db.engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_partial_update_only_title_leaves_other_fields_unchanged():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Original Title", "description": "Keep this", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    task_id = r.json()["id"]

    r2 = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "New Title"})
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    body = r2.json()
    assert body["id"] == task_id
    assert body["title"] == "New Title"
    assert body["description"] == "Keep this"
    assert body["completed"] == False

tests.name: test_partial_update_each_field_independently_via_decision_table
preconditions: App is running in-process with a fresh SQLite database
Tasks created fresh for each sub-case
actions: Create task, PUT with only description changed
Create task, PUT with only completed changed to False (already False, idempotent)
Verify each time that the non-updated fields retain original values
expected: Updating only description: HTTP 200, description updated, title and completed unchanged
Updating completed=False on already-False task: HTTP 200, completed still False, title unchanged
